definitionValue: fun c j => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (j + 1), c i
type: (ℕ → ℚ) → ℕ → ℚ

definitionValue:
fun n j s W =>
  ZetaNine.CoefficientMapTelescoper.prefixSum (fun i => ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.weightedLocalCoefficient n i s W) j
type: ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℚ[X] → ℚ

definitionValue:
fun n W t =>
  ∑ j ∈ Finset.range n,
    ∑ s ∈ Finset.Icc 1 9, ZetaNine.CoefficientMapTelescoper.cumulativeCoefficient n j s W / (t + ↑j) ^ s
type: ℕ → ℚ[X] → ℚ → ℚ

definitionValue:
fun n W =>
  ∑ j ∈ Finset.range n,
    ∑ s ∈ Finset.Icc 1 9,
      Polynomial.C (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapTelescoper.cumulativeCoefficient n j s W) *
        ZetaNine.CoefficientMapReflection.partialBasis (n - 1) j s
type: ℕ → ℚ[X] → ℚ[X]

definitionValue:
fun n i =>
  match i with
  | Sum.inl k => ↑↑k + 1
  | Sum.inr k => -↑n - ↑↑k
type: (n : ℕ) → Fin (n + 1) ⊕ Fin (n + 1) → ℚ

definitionValue: fun n => ∏ i, (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapTelescoper.rootNode n i))
type: ℕ → ℚ[X]

∀ (c : ℕ → ℚ) (j : ℕ),
  ZetaNine.CoefficientMapTelescoper.prefixSum c (j + 1) = ZetaNine.CoefficientMapTelescoper.prefixSum c j + c (j + 1)

∀ (n : ℕ) (c f : ℕ → ℚ),
  ∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, ZetaNine.CoefficientMapTelescoper.prefixSum c j * (f j - f (j + 1)) =
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), c j * f j - ZetaNine.CoefficientMapTelescoper.prefixSum c n * f n

∀ (n j s : ℕ) (W : ℚ[X]),
  ZetaNine.CoefficientMapTelescoper.cumulativeCoefficient n (j + 1) s W =
    ZetaNine.CoefficientMapTelescoper.cumulativeCoefficient n j s W +
      ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.weightedLocalCoefficient n (j + 1) s W

∀ (n : ℕ),
  Even n →
    ∀ (W : ℚ[X]),
      ZetaNine.CoefficientMapReflection.StrongProperMultiplier n W →
        ZetaNine.CoefficientMapAggregate.aggregate n W = 0 →
          ∀ (s : ℕ), 1 ≤ s → s ≤ 9 → ZetaNine.CoefficientMapTelescoper.cumulativeCoefficient n n s W = 0

∀ (n : ℕ) (W : ℚ[X]) (t : ℚ),
  ZetaNine.CoefficientMapTelescoper.telescoper n W t =
    ∑ s ∈ Finset.Icc 1 9,
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, ZetaNine.CoefficientMapTelescoper.cumulativeCoefficient n j s W / (t + ↑j) ^ s

∀ (n : ℕ),
  Even n →
    ∀ (W : ℚ[X]),
      ZetaNine.CoefficientMapReflection.StrongProperMultiplier n W →
        ZetaNine.CoefficientMapAggregate.aggregate n W = 0 →
          ∀ (t : ℚ),
            ZetaNine.CoefficientMapTelescoper.telescoper n W t -
                ZetaNine.CoefficientMapTelescoper.telescoper n W (t + 1) =
              ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
                ∑ s ∈ Finset.Icc 1 9, ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.weightedLocalCoefficient n j s W / (t + ↑j) ^ s

∀ (n : ℕ),
  Even n →
    ∀ (W : ℚ[X]),
      ZetaNine.CoefficientMapReflection.StrongProperMultiplier n W →
        ZetaNine.CoefficientMapAggregate.aggregate n W = 0 →
          ∀ (t : ℚ),
            (∀ k ≤ n, t + ↑k ≠ 0) →
              ZetaNine.CoefficientMap.weightedR n W t =
                ZetaNine.CoefficientMapTelescoper.telescoper n W t -
                  ZetaNine.CoefficientMapTelescoper.telescoper n W (t + 1)

∀ (n : ℕ) (W : ℚ[X]),
  Filter.Tendsto (fun T => ↑(ZetaNine.CoefficientMapTelescoper.telescoper n W ↑(T + 1))) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

∀ (n T : ℕ),
  Even n →
    ∀ (W : ℚ[X]),
      ZetaNine.CoefficientMapReflection.StrongProperMultiplier n W →
        ZetaNine.CoefficientMapAggregate.aggregate n W = 0 →
          ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.finiteL n T W =
            ZetaNine.CoefficientMapTelescoper.telescoper n W 1 -
              ZetaNine.CoefficientMapTelescoper.telescoper n W ↑(T + 1)

∀ (n : ℕ),
  Even n →
    ∀ (W : ℚ[X]),
      ZetaNine.CoefficientMapReflection.StrongProperMultiplier n W →
        ZetaNine.CoefficientMapAggregate.aggregate n W = 0 → ZetaNine.CoefficientMapTelescoper.telescoper n W 1 = 0
∀ (n k : ℕ) (W : ℚ[X]), 1 ≤ k → k ≤ n → ZetaNine.CoefficientMap.weightedR n W ↑k = 0

∀ (n k : ℕ),
  Even n →
    ∀ (W : ℚ[X]),
      ZetaNine.CoefficientMapReflection.StrongProperMultiplier n W →
        ZetaNine.CoefficientMapAggregate.aggregate n W = 0 →
          1 ≤ k → k ≤ n + 1 → ZetaNine.CoefficientMapTelescoper.telescoper n W ↑k = 0

∀ (n j s : ℕ),
  Even n →
    ∀ (W : ℚ[X]),
      ZetaNine.CoefficientMapReflection.StrongProperMultiplier n W →
        ZetaNine.CoefficientMapAggregate.aggregate n W = 0 →
          j < n →
            1 ≤ s →
              s ≤ 9 →
                ZetaNine.CoefficientMapTelescoper.cumulativeCoefficient n (n - 1 - j) s W =
                  (-1) ^ s * ZetaNine.CoefficientMapTelescoper.cumulativeCoefficient n j s W

∀ (n : ℕ),
  1 ≤ n →
    Even n →
      ∀ (W : ℚ[X]),
        ZetaNine.CoefficientMapReflection.StrongProperMultiplier n W →
          ZetaNine.CoefficientMapAggregate.aggregate n W = 0 →
            ∀ (t : ℚ),
              ZetaNine.CoefficientMapTelescoper.telescoper n W (1 - ↑n - t) =
                ZetaNine.CoefficientMapTelescoper.telescoper n W t

∀ (n k : ℕ),
  1 ≤ n →
    Even n →
      ∀ (W : ℚ[X]),
        ZetaNine.CoefficientMapReflection.StrongProperMultiplier n W →
          ZetaNine.CoefficientMapAggregate.aggregate n W = 0 →
            k ≤ n → ZetaNine.CoefficientMapTelescoper.telescoper n W (-↑n - ↑k) = 0

∀ (n j s : ℕ) (a t : ℚ),
  j ≤ n →
    1 ≤ s →
      s ≤ 9 →
        (∀ k ≤ n, t + ↑k ≠ 0) →
          a * Polynomial.eval t (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapPartialFractions.clearedPolePolynomial n j) ^ 9 *
                (t + ↑j) ^ (9 - s) /
              Polynomial.eval t (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapInjectivity.polePolynomial n) ^ 9 =
            a / (t + ↑j) ^ s

∀ (n : ℕ),
  1 ≤ n →
    ∀ (W : ℚ[X]) (t : ℚ),
      (∀ k < n, t + ↑k ≠ 0) →
        ZetaNine.CoefficientMapTelescoper.telescoper n W t =
          Polynomial.eval t (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapTelescoper.telescoperNumerator n W) /
            Polynomial.eval t (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapInjectivity.polePolynomial (n - 1)) ^ 9
∀ (n : ℕ), 1 ≤ n → ∀ (W : ℚ[X]), (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapTelescoper.telescoperNumerator n W).natDegree ≤ 9 * n - 1
∀ (n : ℕ), Function.Injective (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapTelescoper.rootNode n)
∀ (n : ℕ), (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapTelescoper.rootPolynomial n).Monic

∀ (n : ℕ),
  ZetaNine.CoefficientMapTelescoper.rootPolynomial n =
    (∏ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (↑k + 1))) *
      ∏ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C ↑n + Polynomial.C ↑k)
∀ (n : ℕ), (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapTelescoper.rootPolynomial n).natDegree = 2 * n + 2

∀ (n : ℕ),
  1 ≤ n →
    Even n →
      ∀ (W : ℚ[X]),
        ZetaNine.CoefficientMapReflection.StrongProperMultiplier n W →
          ZetaNine.CoefficientMapAggregate.aggregate n W = 0 →
            ∀ (i : Fin (n + 1) ⊕ Fin (n + 1)),
              Polynomial.eval (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapTelescoper.rootNode n i)
                  (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapTelescoper.telescoperNumerator n W) =
                0

∀ (n : ℕ),
  1 ≤ n →
    Even n →
      ∀ (W : ℚ[X]),
        ZetaNine.CoefficientMapReflection.StrongProperMultiplier n W →
          ZetaNine.CoefficientMapAggregate.aggregate n W = 0 →
            ZetaNine.CoefficientMapTelescoper.rootPolynomial n ∣
              ZetaNine.CoefficientMapTelescoper.telescoperNumerator n W

∀ (n : ℕ),
  1 ≤ n →
    Even n →
      ∀ (W : ℚ[X]),
        ZetaNine.CoefficientMapReflection.StrongProperMultiplier n W →
          ZetaNine.CoefficientMapAggregate.aggregate n W = 0 →
            ∃ H,
              ZetaNine.CoefficientMapTelescoper.telescoperNumerator n W =
                  ZetaNine.CoefficientMapTelescoper.rootPolynomial n * H ∧
                H.natDegree ≤ 7 * n - 3

∀ (n : ℕ),
  2 ≤ n →
    Even n →
      ∀ (W : ℚ[X]),
        W.natDegree ≤ 4 →
          ZetaNine.CoefficientMapAggregate.aggregate n W = 0 →
            (∀ (t : ℚ),
                (∀ k ≤ n, t + ↑k ≠ 0) →
                  ZetaNine.CoefficientMap.weightedR n W t =
                    ZetaNine.CoefficientMapTelescoper.telescoper n W t -
                      ZetaNine.CoefficientMapTelescoper.telescoper n W (t + 1)) ∧
              ZetaNine.CoefficientMapTelescoper.telescoper n W 1 = 0 ∧
                (∀ (t : ℚ),
                    ZetaNine.CoefficientMapTelescoper.telescoper n W (1 - ↑n - t) =
                      ZetaNine.CoefficientMapTelescoper.telescoper n W t) ∧
                  (∀ (k : ℕ), 1 ≤ k → k ≤ n + 1 → ZetaNine.CoefficientMapTelescoper.telescoper n W ↑k = 0) ∧
                    (∀ k ≤ n, ZetaNine.CoefficientMapTelescoper.telescoper n W (-↑n - ↑k) = 0) ∧
                      ZetaNine.CoefficientMapTelescoper.rootPolynomial n ∣
                        ZetaNine.CoefficientMapTelescoper.telescoperNumerator n W
∀ (n : ℕ), 1 ≤ n → ∀ (i : Fin (n + 1) ⊕ Fin (n + 1)), ∀ k < n, ZetaNine.CoefficientMapTelescoper.rootNode n i + ↑k ≠ 0

∀ (n : ℕ),
  1 ≤ n →
    Even n →
      ∀ (W : ℚ[X]),
        ZetaNine.CoefficientMapReflection.StrongProperMultiplier n W →
          ZetaNine.CoefficientMapAggregate.aggregate n W = 0 →
            ∃ H,
              H.natDegree ≤ 7 * n - 3 ∧
                ZetaNine.CoefficientMapTelescoper.telescoperNumerator n W =
                    ZetaNine.CoefficientMapTelescoper.rootPolynomial n * H ∧
                  ∀ (t : ℚ),
                    (∀ k < n, t + ↑k ≠ 0) →
                      ZetaNine.CoefficientMapTelescoper.telescoper n W t =
                        Polynomial.eval t (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapTelescoper.rootPolynomial n) * Polynomial.eval t H /
                          Polynomial.eval t (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapInjectivity.polePolynomial (n - 1)) ^ 9

∀ (n T : ℕ),
  Even n →
    ∀ (W : ℚ[X]),
      ZetaNine.CoefficientMapReflection.StrongProperMultiplier n W →
        ZetaNine.CoefficientMapAggregate.aggregate n W = 0 →
          ∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, ZetaNine.CoefficientMap.weightedR n W ↑t =
            ZetaNine.CoefficientMapTelescoper.telescoper n W 1 -
              ZetaNine.CoefficientMapTelescoper.telescoper n W ↑(T + 1)
